question: At which transformer stage does a canonical two-disc state become linearly readable and evolve like a low-capacity port-Hamiltonian free-flow map?

stateDecoders.stateOnly: ridge-linear map trained jointly on t and t+1 endpoints
stateDecoders.statePlusDelta: same linear map with additional normalized one-step feature and state difference constraints

method.tokenSelection: entity patches selected only from rendered categorical pixels
method.freeFlowFit: event-free transitions with no active reset timer
method.hamiltonianMap: two tied position gains, unit momentum decay
method.portHamiltonianMap: two tied position gains and two non-negative momentum decays
method.mlpControl: two-layer tanh delta predictor; entity-pair readout only
method.importantDistinction: transformer depth is computation depth; every dynamics fit compares the same stage across consecutive physical times
